value.rationale: The edgewise maximum norm is the exact worst-case amplification of bounded measurement errors in Hodge/gradient reconstruction, unlike Euclidean nonexpansivity. Open two-rail ladders form a canonical connected family with increasing cycle rank. The result determines all-size sharp stability, identifies the changing mechanism at precisely five rungs, proves no rail edge attains worst case thereafter, gives realizable finite extremizers and quantifies sharp finite-size effects with different even/odd leading constants. These are motivated structural robustness facts, not arbitrary small tables or mere known-kernel repetition.
